title: Jump Game II

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10000 values in [0,1000]. The last index is reachable.

statement: Start at index 0. At index i you can jump forward by any positive distance up to nums[i], staying within the array. Return the fewest jumps needed to reach the last index.

examples.explanation: Landing at index 1 gives a direct jump to the end.
Jump directly from the first index to the last.

constraints: 1–10000 values in [0,1000]. The last index is reachable.
hints: Conceptual: The destination may already be the starting position.
Directional: Think of all indices reachable in the same number of jumps as one layer.
Implementation: Scan the current layer while computing the next boundary. Increment the jump count only when leaving the current layer.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
